description: Calculates Polish late-payment interest for one or more overdue amounts — statutory (art. 481 Civil Code), commercial-transactions or a custom rate — using the current National Bank of Poland reference rate, exact to the grosz. Returns days late, the rate and the interest. To issue a formal interest note use create_interest_note.

annual_rate_percent.description: Annual rate in percent when rate_type is custom, e.g. 12.5

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the amounts, default PLN

invoices.description: Invoices or other amounts paid late / still unpaid

amount.description: Amount paid late or still outstanding, e.g. 12300.50

payment_date.description: Date of payment, YYYY-MM-DD; omit when still unpaid — interest is then counted up to today

rate_type.description: statutory = Polish statutory late-payment interest (art. 481 Civil Code, default); commercial = rate for transactions between businesses; custom = contractual rate given in annual_rate_percent

name: calculate_late_payment_interest
title: Calculate late-payment interest (Poland)
